other_conditions: Applicant must be a new or existing business unit.
Unit must have its operations located in Goa.
Unit must be one of the following legal entities: Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership.
Bank accounts of the unit and its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar.
Employee count is based on employees who have been on the rolls for more than 12 months during the year.
For expansion, new employees must have been on the rolls for at least one year prior to the date of application.
Unit must achieve an annual growth of at least 20% per annum for a continuous period of three years.
At least 75% of the total employees must be Goans or Goan graduates.
Female employees must constitute at least 60% of the workforce.
All Goan employees must have the required certifications as per policy section 6.4.1.
The unit must obtain at least one quality certification during the policy period as per policy section 6.2.10.
Units will be evaluated at the end of each fiscal year to verify continued eligibility for the subsidy.
Applications may be submitted on a quarterly, bi‑annual or annual basis after the relevant expenditure has been incurred.
benefits_summary: Units receive a special incentive allowance of up to ₹2,00,00,000 (₹50,00,000 for smaller units, ₹1,00,00,000 for other units) once every three years.
